BKS1#0.quote: It is situated in Parvati Valley , on the banks of the Parvati River between Bhuntar and Manikaran .

BKS2#0.quote: Kasol is a popular Himalayan destination for backpackers and acts as a base for nearby treks to Malana and Kheerganga .

BKS5#0.quote: Kasol is only connected to the rest of India by well-developed roads.
